name: Cherubim
source:
Everything that has ever existed, from the mountains up high to the waters down below, are products of Cherubim's hard work.

She is but one of 8 God Fragments that make up what we know as "God."

Next to dinosaurs, humans are his favorite creation the joined Choir has created. They wish things were different between the realms, and are trusting you to make the right choices to see their plan through.
